description: Separates the three things called 'the q0 gate' and shows the deuteron deficit needs only the routine one (evaluate a derived function at the calibrated q0), not the forbidden one (derive q0). Measures that every target quantity is q-free; that b3>0 and b4>0 put the coordination-weight turnover at A>=4, meeting the SU(4) support bound from the opposite direction; that the absent channel carries at least the whole deficit; and that only B(4)/B(2) among the fingerprint coordinates is convention-independent, so the deficit target is known to ~21% at best. Derives no magnitude and proposes no functional.

gate_separation.G2_evaluate_derived_F_at_calibrated_q0: routine -- what every framework prediction does (m_p/m_e, m_K/m_pi, Q_beta)
gate_separation.conclusion: the front terminates at an ordinary open derivation, not at the gate; #6197's 'terminates at the q0 gate' is correct for the route it tested and does not generalise to the front

what_is_established: the gate separation G1/G2/G3: the deficit needs only G2, so the front is an ordinary open derivation and is NOT closed by the 2026-08-02 ruling
a LOWER bound on the coordination-weight turnover at A>=4 from the measured cumulant signs alone, meeting the SU(4) support UPPER bound
v(2) >= b3/3: the absent channel carries at least the whole deficit
only B(4)/B(2) is convention-independent, so the deficit target is known to ~21% and single-number near-matches cannot discriminate
scope.what_would_narrow_the_target: settling the A=3 convention -- a Coulomb correction on 3He and its own shift on 4He -- which is what would let a candidate be discriminated at the few-percent level instead of the ~21% level
scope.what_remains_open: the magnitude. Nothing here proposes a mechanism, and the constraint list in qou-edt7 stands unchanged
corrections_to_prior_work: #6197's 'the deuteron-deficit route terminates at the q0 gate' is correct for the near-unitarity route (which needs G3) and does not generalise to the front (which needs only G2)

an earlier framing of mine, that H2(q) commutativity gives a q-independent vanishing at A=2, is WITHDRAWN: the deuteron's mass/binding-frame braid word is the 3A-strand word (H6, non-abelian) per docs/audits/2026-08-21-deuteron-two-adjudications-reconciled.md; H2 commutativity is a knot-level fact about the 2-strand trefoil
